title: Sync while offline shows an error toast and makes no Google request
preconditions: At least one transaction exists, device offline
steps:
1. Go to Riwayat
2. Click "Sync ke Sheets" while offline
expected_result: Error toast that sync needs internet; no request to Google made

title: Sync with no or expired token triggers a Google auth popup
preconditions: No stored token or token expired, online
steps: 1. Click "Sync ke Sheets"
expected_result: Google popup requesting Sheets & Drive permission; token reused for about 50 minutes afterward

title: Closing the auth popup leaves the button normal with no error
preconditions: Auth popup open from Sync
steps: 1. Close the popup without completing sign-in
expected_result: No error toast; Sync button returns to normal state

title: Sync and Reset are disabled with a spinner while syncing even across tabs
preconditions: A sync is in progress
steps:
1. Start a sync
2. Switch to another tab and back
expected_result: Button reads "Menyinkronkan..." with spinner; both Sync and Reset disabled throughout, including after switching tabs

title: First sync of year T creates a yearly spreadsheet with Summary and monthly tabs
preconditions: No Qicau_Export_T spreadsheet exists yet for year T
steps: 1. Sync transactions for year T for the first time
expected_result: Qicau_Export_T spreadsheet created with a Summary tab and one tab per month with data (e.g. "Mei 2026")

title: Monthly tab layout matches spec for frozen header row order and day label
preconditions: A monthly tab exists with multiple transactions on the same day
steps: 1. Open a monthly tab after a sync
expected_result: Row 1 frozen with headers Hari, Tanggal & Waktu (WIB), Platform / Toko, Kategori, Metode Pembayaran, Harga (Rp), Catatan; rows in ascending time order, one row per transaction; day name only on the first row of each date

title: Monthly tab side stats table is consistent with the data rows
preconditions: A monthly tab with multiple transactions across categories
steps: 1. Compare the "Statistik {Bulan Tahun}" and "Kategori {Bulan Tahun}" tables against the data rows
expected_result: Total Hari, Total Transaksi, Total Pengeluaran, daily averages, and per-category totals all match the underlying rows

title: Summary tab aggregates across months with a pie chart and no frozen row
preconditions: Data across multiple months
steps: 1. Open the Summary tab
expected_result: Cross-month aggregates (Total Hari, Total Transaksi, averages, Total Pengeluaran, per category) plus "Alokasi Pengeluaran (%)" pie chart; no frozen header row

title: Successful sync shows a count-accurate success toast
preconditions: New unsynced transactions exist
steps: 1. Click Sync and wait for completion
expected_result: Success toast "Berhasil menyinkronkan N transaksi baru!" where N = number of genuinely new transactions sent

title: Re-syncing with no new data shows an already-synced toast and no duplicate rows
preconditions: All transactions already synced
steps: 1. Click Sync again with nothing new
expected_result: Toast "Semua data sudah tersinkronisasi..."; no duplicate rows appear in Sheets

title: Re-syncing with some new transactions adds only those and updates stats/summary
preconditions: A mix of already-synced and new transactions
steps: 1. Click Sync
expected_result: Only the new transactions are appended; stats and Summary tab update accordingly

title: Syncing with zero transactions shows a no-data toast and creates no file
preconditions: Account has no transactions at all
steps: 1. Click Sync
expected_result: Toast "Tidak ada data untuk disinkronkan."; no spreadsheet file created

title: Transactions spanning multiple years produce one spreadsheet per year
preconditions: Transactions exist in two different years
steps: 1. Sync
expected_result: A separate spreadsheet is created/used per year

title: Google API error during sync shows an error toast discards the token and marks nothing exported
preconditions: A sync in progress will hit a Google API error
steps: 1. Trigger a sync that fails on the Google side
expected_result: Error toast "Gagal sinkronisasi: ..."; stored token discarded (next sync re-prompts login); transactions are not marked as exported

title: Reset Ekspor requires confirmation and Batal makes no change
preconditions: Online, at least one transaction, Riwayat tab
steps:
1. Click "Reset Ekspor"
2. In the custom confirmation dialog, click "Batal"
expected_result: Custom confirmation dialog (not a native popup) appears; Batal -> no changes

title: Confirming reset marks all transactions unexported and shows a count toast
preconditions: Reset confirmation dialog open
steps: 1. Confirm the reset
expected_result: Google Sheets files Qicau_Export_{year} (all years) moved to Drive Trash; all transactions marked unexported; toast "Berhasil mereset status N transaksi! File Sheets lama dipindahkan ke Trash Drive. ..."; next sync creates a new file and resends everything

title: Reset while offline is blocked with an error toast
preconditions: Device offline
steps: 1. Click "Reset Ekspor" while offline
expected_result: Error toast that internet is needed; no changes made

title: Sync after the year's Sheets file was deleted recreates it with all transactions
preconditions: The Qicau_Export_T file for year T was deleted by the user; some of that year's transactions were previously marked exported
steps: 1. Click Sync
expected_result: A new file is created; all of that year's transactions are sent, including previously-exported ones

title: "Ya, Reset" is disabled for about 1 second after the Reset dialog appears
preconditions: Online, Riwayat tab
steps:
1. Click "Reset Ekspor"
2. Immediately try to click "Ya, Reset"
3. Wait about 1-2 seconds and observe the button
expected_result: Button disabled for ~1s, then enabled normally (test must wait, not click instantly)

title: First sync on this browser shows the educational Google access dialog
preconditions: Online; browser storage cleared (never synced on this browser)
steps:
1. Click "Sync ke Sheets"
2. Read the dialog
3. Click "Batal"
expected_result: Dialog "Izinkan Akses Google Sheets & Drive" explains a Google permission popup is coming; Batal -> no process, no Google popup

title: Confirming the educational dialog continues the normal sync flow
preconditions: SYNC-20 dialog open
steps: 1. Confirm the dialog
expected_result: Continues into the SYNC-02 flow (Google popup if no/expired token, then export)

title: Repeat sync shows the short confirmation dialog without the permission explanation
preconditions: Online; this browser has already synced successfully
steps:
1. Click "Sync ke Sheets"
2. Click "Batal"
expected_result: Short dialog "Sinkronisasi ke Sheets" ("Sinkronkan transaksi terbaru ke Google Sheets sekarang?") with no Google-permission text; Batal -> no process

title: "Has synced" status is per browser, not per Google account
preconditions: One browser that synced successfully before; a second browser/profile with the same account that has not
steps:
1. In browser A (synced before) let the token expire and click Sync
2. In browser B (never synced) click Sync
expected_result: A: short dialog only, even when Google asks to log in again; B: educational dialog

title: Reset with no/expired token asks for Google login first; closing the popup changes nothing
preconditions: Online; no valid Google token
steps:
1. Click "Reset Ekspor" and confirm
2. Close the Google popup without signing in
expected_result: Google login popup appears before anything is moved; after closing it nothing changes (transactions still exported, files not trashed)

title: Reset or Sync failure shows an error toast; a dropped connection stops the process with a connection-lost toast
preconditions: Online, Google token valid; a way to cut the network mid-process; a way to make the Drive/Sheets API fail
steps:
1. Click "Reset Ekspor" (and later "Sync ke Sheets") and confirm
2. Cut the internet while it runs
3. Observe the toast and the buttons
4. Go back online and run it again
5. (separately) make the Drive/Sheets API fail
expected_result: API error: toast "Gagal reset sinkronisasi: ..." and the stored token is discarded; transaction export status unchanged. Connection lost: the process stops with a connection-lost toast (does not hang), status unchanged, and Sync/Reset can be run again after reconnecting

title: Text starting with = + - @ or tab is exported as plain text
preconditions: Transactions whose Platform/Catatan start with =, +, -, @ and a tab; plus normal text; production, own account
steps:
1. Save such transactions via the direct form
2. Sync to Sheets
3. Open the sheet and inspect those cells
expected_result: Cells show as plain text exactly as typed (no formula evaluated, no hyperlink); no visible guard character; normal text unchanged

title: Blocked Google login popup shows a clear error toast and changes nothing
preconditions: Online; browser popups blocked for the site
steps: 1. Click Sync (or Reset Ekspor) and confirm
expected_result: Toast "Jendela login Google diblokir browser. Izinkan popup untuk situs ini, lalu coba lagi."; button back to normal; no data changed

title: Sync/Reset in two tabs at once: second tab refuses to start
preconditions: Same account open in two tabs of the same browser
steps:
1. Start Sync in tab 1
2. While it is running, start Sync (or Reset) in tab 2
expected_result: Tab 2 does not start; toast "Sync atau reset sedang berjalan di tab lain. Tunggu hingga selesai."; no raw Google error; no duplicate rows
